mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS definition_id,p.definition_id AS capability_id,p.id AS capability_version_id, (p.descriptor->>'timeout_ms')::bigint AS timeout_ms FROM nw_workflow_installation_revisions r JOIN nw_workflow_instances i ON i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.id=r.instance_id JOIN nw_workflow_definition_versions anchor ON anchor.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND anchor.id=r.definition_version_id JOIN nw_workflow_definition_versions v ON v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.container_id=anchor.container_id AND v.id=#{definition} JOIN nw_capability_versions p ON p.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND p.id=v.capability_version_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.instance_id=#{instance} AND r.installation_revision=#{revision} AND i.status='published' AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.capability_type='WORKFLOW'

SELECT v.id AS definition_id,p.definition_id AS capability_id,p.id AS capability_version_id, (p.descriptor->>'timeout_ms')::bigint AS timeout_ms,r.installation_revision,c.workflow_id FROM nw_workflow_instances i JOIN nw_workflow_installation_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND r.instance_id=i.id AND r.installation_revision=i.installation_revision JOIN nw_workflow_definition_versions anchor ON anchor.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND anchor.id=r.definition_version_id JOIN nw_workflow_containers c ON c.tenant_id=anchor.tenant_id AND c.id=anchor.container_id JOIN nw_workflow_definition_versions v ON v.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND v.container_id=c.id AND v.id=c.active_definition_version_id JOIN nw_capability_versions p ON p.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND p.id=v.capability_version_id WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND i.id=#{instance} AND i.status='published' AND c.status IN ('draft','published') AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.capability_type='WORKFLOW'

SELECT tenant_id, instance_id, installation_revision, definition_version_id, config, custom_prompt, bindings, created_at FROM nw_workflow_installation_revisions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND instance_id=#{instance} AND installation_revision=#{revision}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_workflow_instances SET installation_revision=#{revision},definition_version_id=#{definition},status='published',updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{instance} AND installation_revision=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM nw_workflow_installation_revisions r JOIN nw_workflow_instances i ON i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.id=r.instance_id JOIN nw_workflow_definition_versions v ON v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.id=r.definition_version_id JOIN nw_workflow_containers c ON c.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND c.id=v.container_id JOIN nw_capability_versions p ON p.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND p.id=v.capability_version_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.instance_id=#{instance} AND r.installation_revision=#{revision} AND c.workflow_id=#{workflow} AND i.status='published' AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.capability_type='WORKFLOW' )
